newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bovespa sees 341 mln-real foreign inflow in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Bovespa sees 341 mln-real foreign inflow in Sept.

text.p: The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said it registered net foreign capital inflows of 340.98 million reais in the first 20 days of SDeptember.
Foreign buys amounted to 1.566 million reais versus foreign sells of 1.225 million reais, the bourse said.
In August, the Bovespa saw net capital inflows of 331.5 million reais, it said.
So far this year, net foreign capital inflows have totalled 1.921 billion reais, the bolsa said.
